meaning: to reverse a car; to back up (not the "change buses" sense)

senses.en: to reverse a car; to back up (not the "change buses" sense)

note: Said by drivers and in parking: 倒车请注意 "Caution, reversing".

examples.zh: 请慢慢倒车，后面有孩子。
examples.en: Please reverse slowly; there are children behind.

examples.zh: 他不会倒车，所以不敢停在这儿。
examples.en: He can't reverse, so he doesn't dare park here.

examples.zh: 你看着后面，慢慢倒车。
examples.en: Keep an eye behind you and reverse slowly.

examples.zh: 山上有很多松树。
examples.en: There are many pine trees on the mountain.

examples.zh: 这棵松树已经有一百多年了。
examples.en: This pine tree is already over a hundred years old.

examples.zh: 松树冬天也是绿的。
examples.en: Pine trees are green even in winter.

note: In China you usually ask 要发票吗 / 开发票 when paying.

examples.zh: 请给我开一张发票。
examples.en: Please issue me an invoice.

examples.zh: 买东西的时候，别忘了要发票。
examples.en: When you buy things, don't forget to ask for a receipt.

examples.zh: 这家店可以开发票吗？
examples.en: Can this shop issue an invoice?

examples.zh: 春天到了，花园里的花都开花了。
examples.en: Spring has come and the flowers in the garden are blooming.

examples.zh: 这棵树每年春天开花。
examples.en: This tree flowers every spring.

examples.zh: 你家的草还没开花吗？
examples.en: Hasn't the plant at your home bloomed yet?

examples.zh: 用刷子把鞋刷干净吧。
examples.en: Use a brush to clean your shoes.

examples.zh: 我想买一把新刷子洗衣服。
examples.en: I want to buy a new brush for washing clothes.

examples.zh: 这把刷子太小了。
examples.en: This brush is too small.

meaning: to develop (a new product, drug, or device)

senses.en: to develop (a new product, drug, or device)

note: Used for new products, drugs and equipment, often in news.

examples.zh: 这家公司正在研制一种新药。
examples.en: This company is developing a new drug.

examples.zh: 他们研制成功了一种新手机。
examples.en: They successfully developed a new kind of phone.

examples.zh: 这种药是谁研制的？
examples.en: Who developed this medicine?

examples.zh: 北方的冬天到处都是冰雪。
examples.en: In winter, the north is covered in ice and snow everywhere.

examples.zh: 很多人去东北看冰雪世界。
examples.en: Many people go to Harbin to see the ice and snow world.

examples.zh: 冰雪慢慢化了，春天要来了。
examples.en: The ice and snow are slowly melting; spring is coming.

meaning: to be divided into; to split into (parts)

senses.en: to be divided into; to split into (parts)

note: Pattern: A 分为 B 和 C.

examples.zh: 这本书分为两部分。
examples.en: This book is divided into two parts.

examples.zh: 我们班分为三个小组。
examples.en: Our class is divided into three groups.

examples.zh: 一年可以分为四个季节。
examples.en: A year can be divided into four seasons.

meaning: one after another; in large numbers

senses.en: one after another; in large numbers

note: Goes before the verb; the subject is plural: 大家纷纷…

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，大家纷纷说好。
examples.en: Hearing the news, everyone said it was great, one after another.

examples.zh: 秋天到了，树叶纷纷落下来。
examples.en: Autumn has come and the leaves are falling one after another.

examples.zh: 很多人纷纷表示同意。
examples.en: Many people said one after another that they agreed.

examples.zh: 他在工作中积累了很多经验。
examples.en: He has accumulated a lot of experience at work.

examples.zh: 每天记十个词，慢慢积累。
examples.en: Learn ten words every day and build up slowly.

examples.zh: 钱要一点儿一点儿地积累。
examples.en: Money has to be saved up bit by bit.

examples.zh: 请给我一瓶矿泉水。
examples.en: Please give me a bottle of mineral water.

examples.zh: 开会的时候，桌子上有矿泉水。
examples.en: During the meeting there is bottled water on the table.

examples.zh: 超市里的矿泉水多少钱一瓶？
examples.en: How much is a bottle of mineral water in the supermarket?

meaning: to recuperate; to convalesce (at a rest place)

senses.en: to recuperate; to convalesce (at a rest place)

note: Often 去疗养院 / 到海边疗养.

examples.zh: 医生让他去海边疗养一个月。
examples.en: The doctor told him to recuperate by the sea for a month.

examples.zh: 爷爷生病以后，一直在山上疗养。
examples.en: After Grandpa fell ill, he has been recuperating in the mountains.

examples.zh: 这里空气好，适合疗养。
examples.en: The air here is good and suits convalescence.

examples.zh: 请在前头的路口停车。
examples.en: Please stop at the intersection ahead.

examples.zh: 你先走，我在前头等你。
examples.en: You go first; I'll wait for you up ahead.

examples.zh: 前头有一家很好的饭馆。
examples.en: There is a very good restaurant up ahead.

note: Goes before the verb, e.g. 一再强调, 一再说.

examples.zh: 医生一再说，一定要按时吃药。
examples.en: The doctor said again and again that I must take the medicine on time.

examples.zh: 他一再说对不起，我就不生气了。
examples.en: He said sorry again and again, so I stopped being angry.

examples.zh: 老师一再提醒我们不要迟到。
examples.en: The teacher repeatedly reminded us not to be late.

meaning: to bring in; to introduce (from abroad or outside)

senses.en: to bring in; to introduce (from abroad or outside)

examples.zh: 这家医院引进了新的设备。
examples.en: This hospital has brought in new equipment.

examples.zh: 他们想从国外引进一些好技术。
examples.en: They want to bring in some good technology from abroad.

examples.zh: 学校引进了几位外国老师。
examples.en: The school brought in several foreign teachers.

examples.zh: 汉语语法不太难，但是词很多。
examples.en: Chinese grammar is not too hard, but there are many words.

examples.zh: 这个句子的语法有问题。
examples.en: There is a grammar problem in this sentence.

examples.zh: 老师，能再说一次这个语法吗？
examples.en: Teacher, could you explain this grammar point once more?

examples.zh: 我月底要去北京开会。
examples.en: I'm going to Beijing for a meeting at the end of the month.

examples.zh: 房租要在月底以前交。
examples.en: The rent has to be paid before the end of the month.

examples.zh: 你月底有时间吗？
examples.en: Do you have time at the end of the month?

meaning: it is clear that; one can see that

senses.en: it is clear that; one can see that

note: Starts a conclusion drawn from what was just said.

examples.zh: 他每天都练习，可见他很努力。
examples.en: He practices every day; clearly, he works hard.

examples.zh: 这么多人排队，可见这家店很受欢迎。
examples.en: So many people are queuing, so clearly this shop is popular.

examples.zh: 他没回我的信息，可见他很忙。
examples.en: He didn't reply to my message, so he must be very busy.

note: Often after the verb: 考虑再三, 再三说明.

examples.zh: 我再三考虑以后，决定不去了。
examples.en: After thinking it over repeatedly, I decided not to go.

examples.zh: 妈妈再三说，路上要小心。
examples.en: Mom said over and over to be careful on the road.

examples.zh: 他再三说明，这件事和他没有关系。
examples.en: He explained again and again that this has nothing to do with him.

examples.zh: 这件衣服的颜色很鲜明。
examples.en: The color of this garment is vivid.

examples.zh: 他的态度很鲜明，不同意。
examples.en: His stance is clear-cut: he doesn't agree.

examples.zh: 这个房间的对比很鲜明。
examples.en: The contrast in this room is sharp.
